Levels — the test pyramid

Unit 448 · Integration 31 · System/API 56 · E2E UI 15 · UAT 4

Black-box design

  • BVA robust 6n+1 on 16 inputs; normal 4n+1 and worst-case 5ⁿ for nights × rooms
  • ECP valid + invalid classes, one invalid at a time — found DEF-001
  • Decision tables refund (32 → 8 rules), benefits (2⁴ = 16), sign-in lock-out
  • Cause-effect graph E1 = C1∧C2∧C4, E2 = C1∨(C2∧C3) → 10 cases
  • State transition all 30 cells of the 6 × 5 table + 8 sequences
  • Pairwise 288 → 20 cases checked by an independent oracle; property-based invariants

White-box coverage

V(G) = E − N + 2P = 23 − 17 + 2 = 8 → 8 basis paths
  • Statement → branch → condition → MC/DC (N+1) worked on real decisions
  • Data-flow all-defs / all-uses; loop 0, 1, 2, m, n−1, n
  • Coverage 97.8% → 99.9% via coverage-guided tests

Performance — DEF-004 found and fixed

Book + pay p95 663 → 201 ms after WAL tuning; load, stress, spike, soak and volume all at 0 % errors.

Security, accessibility, reliability

  • OWASP A01/A02/A03/A05/A07: IDOR, escalation, SQLi, stored + DOM XSS, brute force, enumeration, headers
  • axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA: 0 violations; keyboard-only flow; 4 device layouts
  • 20-thread race for 3 suites → exactly 3 bookings, 25/25 repeats
  • Gateway timeout/decline recovery; idempotent payments; restart persistence
